message.content:
This is a CBP ruling on propane tanker trailers. The candidate headings are 8716 (trailers and semi-trailers; other vehicles not mechanically propelled) and 7311 (containers for compressed or liquefied gas, of iron or steel).

I recall the ruling as classifying the item in 8716.80.5090, "Other vehicles: Other: Other." The trailer is towed by tractors or animals, and it is not designed for highway use. Heading 8716.39 covers tanker trailers for agricultural use, but I believe the ruling went to 8716.31 or 8716.39. Heading 8716.31 covers "Tanker trailers and tanker semi-trailers", and 8716.39 covers "Other: agricultural". I can't pin down which one applies from the facts, so I am reasoning from the text.

The HTSUS 8716.31.00 reads "Tanker trailers and tanker semi-trailers," and its statistical suffixes are 8716.31.0010 (Tanker trailers and semi-trailers: for the transport of ... ) and 8716.31.0050. The 8716.31 subheading is the more specific fit for a tank on wheels carrying propane. The Section XVII notes do not exclude it.

The rule that applies is GRI 1: the goods are tanker trailers, and 8716.31 fits. Under 8716.31.00, the statistical suffix I recall is 0010 for "Tanker trailers and tanker semitrailers: Of a kind used for agricultural purposes?" I am not sure of that, so I am choosing 8716.31.0000 with the suffix as best I recall it.

predicted_reason: A wheeled, towed propane tank assembly is a tanker trailer, which falls under heading 8716 (trailers and other non-mechanically propelled vehicles) and subheading 8716.31 (tanker trailers and tanker semi-trailers) rather than heading 7311 (containers).
